title: Carbon-aware scheduling on coal-dominated island grids: code, data and results
description:
Simulation code, input data and complete results for the article Model-based marginal emission signals for carbon-aware scheduling on coal-dominated island grids: a computational regime map along Indonesia's transition pathway (submitted to the Journal of Computational Science).

An hourly merit-order dispatch model of Indonesian island grids (Jawa-Bali, Sumatera, South Sulawesi), calibrated to the official 2024 energy mix, yields average carbon intensity and marginal emission signals. Carbon-aware schedulers for delay-tolerant data-centre jobs are evaluated by consequential accounting (re-dispatch). Included: the Jupyter notebook that produced every result, the digitized 2024 Jawa-Bali load shape (PLN UIP2B), 32 result tables, 9 figures (PDF and PNG), raw Sobol runs and SHA-256 checksums. See README.md.

Licences: code MIT; data and results CC BY 4.0. Electricity Maps traces (ODbL) are not redistributed; they are downloaded at run time.
